image_description: A metallic, silver-colored statue or figure of a humanoid torso wearing a full-body suit of armor. The armor features a prominent breastplate with a central vertical ridge, curved shoulder pauldrons, and articulated arm guards. The figure's hands are clasped at the waist. The background is a blurred outdoor scene with trees and sky.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The hands are fused together in an unnatural clasp. Individual fingers are indistinct and appear melted into each other and the waist armor. The anatomy of the hands is structurally ambiguous and lacks clear definition.

The transition between the upper arm and forearm armor is overly smooth and lacks the mechanical articulation expected in plate armor. It resembles flexible fabric or skin more than rigid metal plates.
The shoulder pauldron seems slightly asymmetrical compared to the right side, with a subtle warping in the curve that doesn't perfectly match the opposing side's geometry.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is classified correctly as a breastplate or suit of armor and not misidentified as a generic robot or statue.
To detect fusion artifacts where the hands meet the body/armor, checking for boundary bleeding.
To verify the 3D curvature of the breastplate is physically consistent and not flattened or distorted.
To assess overall rendering quality, specifically looking for smearing or low-frequency noise in the metallic textures.

focus_areas: Hand anatomy and fusion with waist
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the hands. AI generators often struggle with hands, especially when they are interacting with objects or the body. Check if the 'clasp' is physically possible or if fingers are missing/melted. Also, evaluate if the armor looks like rigid metal or if it has 'rubbery' deformations at the joints.
